quote: Operation Type - Allows you to define a specific action requirement. It is used purely for design purposes to control steps that you would like to execute in the linked process.
None — Indicates that there is no input data for the linked process.
Single Data — Indicates that a single document can be posted to the Simple URL path for each client request.
